title: 감사연구원 운영규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00003:part:1/1

Article 2 (Scope of Duties)
The Audit and Inspection Research Institute (hereinafter referred to as the "Institute") shall perform duties relating to support for establishing audit and inspection infrastructure, including the research and development of audit and inspection systems and methods concerning the audit of accounts, performance auditing and inspection of official duties relating to the major policies, projects and institutional operation of agencies subject to audit and inspection, and investigation and research concerning various audit and inspection systems and methods.
